{"id":1859139246,"question_id":4146,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766078695,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1859139246/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Total Score of Dungeon Runs","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long totalScore(int hp, vector<int>& damage, vector<int>& requirement) {\n        int n = damage.size();\n\n        long long sum = 0;\n        long long ans = 0;\n\n        int l = 0;\n        for(int i=0 ; i < n ; i++){\n            sum += damage[i];\n\n            long long bearable_limit = hp - requirement[i];\n            while(l <= i and sum > bearable_limit){\n                sum -= damage[l];\n                l++;\n                \n            }\n            ans += (i - l + 1);\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"total-score-of-dungeon-runs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1353}
